Package com.eventlottery.model

Class Admin

java.lang.Object
com.eventlottery.model.AbstractUser
com.eventlottery.model.Admin
public class Admin extends AbstractUser
Represents an Admin user who can also act as an Attendee and Event Organizer. Admins are currently stored in the "attendees" collection.
